title: Oneshot Gems: a free MCP that lets Claude Code build Wii Sports-style games you play with your body through your webcam
author: singing_coach_ai
selftext:
I wanted Wii Sports again, in a browser tab, with no console. So I built an MCP that makes games you can play with your body. It's really fun!

**Play it here:** [https://oneshotgems.ai/app/game/3b5fhco5cf92?s=7sxgmnit](https://oneshotgems.ai/app/game/3b5fhco5cf92?s=7sxgmnit)

**How it works**

\- Tracking runs on your device (hand/body/face/voice models).

\- The MCP gives Claude Code the SDK (assets, on-device models, multiplayer, lobbies etc), the rules and a local preview that runs the camera, so it can test what it builds.

\- Send a friend a link to play; friends in a lobby see each other's cameras like a video call.

\- Make your own: [oneshotgems.ai/developers/mcp](http://oneshotgems.ai/developers/mcp)
